title: 屋台（手押し車）
description: 夜の街角に出る木製の手押し屋台です。板張りの車体と客側カウンター、木製スポークの大車輪と鉄輪・車軸、押し手と休み脚、四隅の柱とトタンの切妻屋根、無地の藍色のれん、赤い提灯と骨組み、寸胴鍋と火口、具材入れを造形しています。のれんと提灯は無地で、屋号などの文字、食品、人物、走行・開閉動作は含みません。 ゲーム・可視化向け。製造・構造設計・3Dプリント用途は未検証。 外接寸法（X×Y×Z）2.470 × 2.482 × 1.518 m、17,912三角形。単位m・Y-up、水平中央の接地用原点、最下点Y=0。部品ごとの重複UV0と単色PBR材質を収録し、画像テクスチャ・UV2・コライダー・LOD・リグ・動作は付属しません。静的表示用でUnity/VRChat実機検証は未実施。STLはm・Y-up座標の形状のみで色・材質・UV・階層を含みません。
descriptionEn: A wooden pushcart food stall for night-time street corners. It models the planked body and customer counter, large wooden-spoked wheels with iron tyres and axle, push handles and rest legs, corner posts with a corrugated gabled roof, plain indigo curtain panels, a red paper lantern with ribs, a stock pot on a burner ring and ingredient trays. The curtain and lantern are blank, with no shop name or lettering; food, people and wheel or folding motion are not included. For games and visualization; not validated for manufacture, structural engineering or 3D printing. Bounding dimensions (X×Y×Z): 2.470 × 2.482 × 1.518 m; 17,912 triangles. Metres, Y-up, horizontally centered placement origin with minimum Y=0, not an articulation or mounting pivot. Includes overlapping component UV0 and constant-color PBR materials, with no image textures, unique UV2, colliders, LOD, rig or runtime behavior. Static visualization only; Unity/VRChat editor and runtime tests have not been performed. STL uses metre-valued Y-up coordinates and contains geometry only, without color, materials, UVs or hierarchy.
author: Claude
uv: Per-component primitive or automatically unwrapped UVs. Overlapping between components; not a packed unique lightmap atlas. Solid-color PBR materials; no external textures. STL has no colors or UVs.
